name: Composite models, DirectQuery and hybrid tables

why.matters: Storage mode is an architecture decision: it fixes latency, cost and which DAX features you can use.
why.failure: A DirectQuery model "for real-time" hammers the ERP database at 9am and the operations team blocks the service account.
why.use: Import by default; DirectQuery or hybrid tables when latency truly matters; Dual for shared dimensions; Direct Lake when data already lives in OneLake.
why.avoid: Choosing DirectQuery because "real time" was said in a meeting. Ask what latency the decision actually needs.

verified.context: Storage modes, composite models and Direct Lake docs, Sept 2026

asg.exp: You choose Dual for dimensions shared between an import agg and a DQ fact, and you can say why.

int.q: Why should dimensions be in Dual storage mode in a composite model?
int.a: Dual lets the engine answer from cache when the query only touches imported tables (the agg) and fall back to DirectQuery when joined to the DQ fact. Import-only dimensions would force a limited relationship to the DQ fact.

A relationship across source groups (e.g. import ↔ DirectQuery from different sources) or many-to-many. No blank row, RELATED does not work, referential integrity not assumed, filters pass as IN lists.

int.q: DirectQuery over a shared semantic model: what is the security and refresh story?
int.a: RLS on the source model applies; the composite can add its own RLS on local tables only. The remote part never refreshes locally; local import tables need their own schedule. Both models must live in workspaces the consumer can access or use "Single sign-on"-like chaining permissions.

int.q: Give three DAX functions that are not supported or are slow over DirectQuery to SQL.
int.a: Time intelligence over non-date columns, EARLIER-style iterators (turned into correlated subqueries), text functions in calculated columns, and DISTINCTCOUNT over large tables generating COUNT(DISTINCT) per group.

int.q: When is Import the wrong choice even if the data fits?
int.a: Regulatory need for real-time data, source of truth that changes every minute, data that must not leave the source system, or a model size that exceeds capacity memory once refreshed (needs 2× during refresh).

ass.q: Assume referential integrity changes the generated SQL from:
o: LEFT OUTER JOIN to INNER JOIN
ass.why: Inner joins are faster but hide fact rows with no matching dimension.

o: Behaves as import or DQ depending on the query
ass.why: Dual is the definition of that behaviour.
